actual: BUG-1382 actual changed files include the approved offline-only backend/services/hmm_risk/rotation_l1_gbdt.py and scripts/hmm_risk/run_rotation_l1_g2a.py. finish --plan-only classifies the first as backend-main and the second as unknown, then blocks explicit runtime_impact=none. The fail-closed contract is correct, but offline classification is split between docs/standards/aistock_runtime_targets_v1.yaml and a Python known_non_runtime_files set; the catalog currently accepts only scripts/*.py or *.ps1 and rejects exact backend offline sources, so every new offline backend module requires another hard-coded workflow patch. The same mismatch is discovered only at finish after parent and stacked PR work is complete. Centralize exact non-runtime source authority in the runtime catalog with strict exact-path validation, register only the two approved files, preserve backend/unknown behavior for unregistered neighbors, and surface actual-diff classification before PR readiness without adding a new gate. Do not change HMM business code, runtime services, experiments, database, dependencies, or process state.
